title: Earlier undisclosed events before WWII

tellings.quote: I mean, there's some other stuff, too, that I can't talk about that was way before that.

plain: David Grusch, a former US intelligence officer who has gone public as a whistleblower about UFOs, told Jesse Michels's podcast that there are other events he cannot talk about that happened well before the cases he was discussing, before about 1944. If true, it would mean contact with non-human craft goes back earlier than the Second World War era.
